methodology: Every entry below was verified against the CURRENT source file by direct read, not assumed from the pre-existing docs/kpi_formula_threshold_action_audit.md or validation/kpi_formula_audit/*.json, both of which were found to contain extensive fabrication (wrong class names, wrong line numbers, an invented CUSUM methodology, an invented governance tier system, invented VaR and Reorder Point metrics). See report.md for the full discrepancy list.

metrics.definition: Total per-period cost the business actually incurs, excluding the artificial shortage penalty.
metrics.formula: sum of included cost components (facility, opening, closure, transport, handling, inventory, carbon) per ResilienceCostBasis flags

metrics.definition: The raw MILP objective value, including the shortage penalty. Kept separate from business_network_cost so the two are never conflated.
metrics.formula: 9 additive terms: facility + opening + closure + transport + handling + inventory + shortage + carbon_cost + carbon_objective

metrics.definition: Fraction of total demand actually served.
metrics.formula: served_demand / total_demand, else 1.0 when total_demand == 0
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.network_kpis()['demand_fill_rate'] — wraps verbatim. NOTE: is a FRACTION [0,1], never a percentage — the pre-existing audit's '×100' claim is wrong.
metrics.edge_case_note: total_demand==0 returns 1.0 by an if/else convention (NOT max(total_demand, 1e-6) as the pre-existing audit claimed). Pre-existing, verified, deliberate; unchanged by this phase.

metrics.definition: Mean utilization across open facilities with positive capacity.
metrics.formula: mean(utilization_pct for open facilities with capacity > 0)
metrics.test_coverage: netgravity/tests/test_hardening_v14.py (non-negativity only — no formula-correctness assertion found)

metrics.definition: Per-facility throughput as a percentage of rated capacity.
metrics.formula: outbound_flow / capacity * 100, else 0.0 when closed or capacity<=0
metrics.test_coverage: none found asserting the exact arithmetic directly

metrics.definition: Network-wide transport carbon footprint.
metrics.formula: sum(distance_km * (flow_units * product.weight_kg / 1000) * emission_factor) across all flows
metrics.unit_note: The unit is kg, NEVER tCO2e — the pre-existing audit's tCO2e claim is wrong; verified by reading the actual formula code, which has no kg->tonne conversion for the CO2 output.

metrics.definition: Total carbon divided by total units served.
metrics.formula: total_carbon_kg / total_served, else 0.0
missing_dependencies: dropped at OptimizationResult -> NetworkStateResult bridge (metrics/contracts.py); never reaches ExecutionContext
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.network_kpis()['carbon_per_unit'] — reports INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with the exact bridge-gap reason

metrics.definition: Flow-weighted average shipment distance across all positive-flow lanes.
metrics.formula: sum(flow_units * distance_km) / sum(flow_units), else 0.0
metrics.frontend_relevance: network efficiency KPI (currently unreachable via ExecutionContext)
missing_dependencies: dropped at OptimizationResult -> NetworkStateResult bridge; never reaches ExecutionContext
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.network_kpis()['weighted_avg_distance_km'] — reports INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with the exact bridge-gap reason
metrics.location_note: The pre-existing audit attributed this to service/cumulative.py; verified that file contains only Dijkstra-based cumulative LEAD-TIME logic, no distance-weighting at all.

metrics.definition: Flow-weighted average distance on Plant/Supplier -> DC arcs.
metrics.formula: sum(flow*dist) / sum(flow) over inbound arcs, else 0.0

metrics.definition: Flow-weighted average distance on DC -> Market arcs.
metrics.formula: sum(flow*dist) / sum(flow) over outbound arcs, else 0.0

metrics.definition: Lowest utilization among open facilities with positive capacity.
metrics.formula: min(utilization_pct for open facilities with capacity > 0)

metrics.definition: Share of total demand delivered within the destination market's transit-time SLA.
metrics.formula: served_in_sla / total_demand * 100, else 100.0 when total_demand == 0
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.network_kpis()['pct_demand_in_sla'] — wraps verbatim, via NetworkStateResult.service (Optional; reports INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if no ServiceReport is present)

metrics.definition: Count of facilities open in the solved network.
metrics.formula: len(open_facilities)

metrics.definition: Relative economic exposure of one facility if it becomes unavailable.
metrics.formula: REI_i = max(0, PI_i) / max_j(max(0, PI_j)), where PI_i = disrupted_business_cost - baseline_business_cost
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.facility_resilience_kpis()[facility_id]['rei'] — wraps verbatim, NOT_COMPUTABLE when the row's rei is None
metrics.formula_note: NOT a 0.5 cost + 0.5 service-loss weighting as the pre-existing audit claimed — a single-term normalization of Performance Impact only. Service loss is tracked as a separate diagnostic field, never fed into REI.

metrics.definition: Deterministic CRITICAL/HIGH/MODERATE/NOT_CLASSIFIED/UNKNOWN label for a facility's resilience row.
metrics.formula: classify_risk(): infeasible -> CRITICAL (default rule, enabled); optional unserved_demand_rate / cost_impact_pct bands (disabled by default); else NOT_CLASSIFIED
metrics.reasoning_relevance: used in narrative but not a grounded numeric claim (it is an enum)
metrics.important_note: Verified NOT_CLASSIFIED is the honest DEFAULT for most facilities: no documented business basis exists for absolute REI bands (schemas/resilience.py:134-138). The pre-existing audit's claim of a 0.70/0.30 threshold-driven risk classification is fabricated.

metrics.definition: Combined probability that risk materialises, from external likelihood and internal resilience exposure.
metrics.formula: RF = P + REI - (P * REI), clamped to [0,1] for float drift only
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: KPIRegistry.facility_risk_kpis()[facility_id]['risk_factor'] — wraps verbatim; NOT_COMPUTABLE (never P=0 default) when either input is missing
metrics.important_note: Verified: a missing P NEVER defaults to 0.0 (which would silently yield RF=REI). risk_factor.py returns RFStatus.NOT_COMPUTABLE with a specific RFNotComputableReason instead. The pre-existing audit's 'defaults to P=0.0' claim is false.

metrics.definition: Claimed by the pre-existing audit as RF * ThroughputValue.
metrics.formula: NONE EXISTS
missing_dependencies: no ThroughputValue field exists on any schema
no VaR/ValueAtRisk identifier exists anywhere in the codebase
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: not implemented — no formula and no input exist to wrap or compute
metrics.verification_note: Confirmed absent by exhaustive, word-bounded grep across the entire netgravity/ tree. Pure documentation invention.

metrics.definition: Claimed by the pre-existing audit as d_mean*LT + SS.
metrics.formula: NONE EXISTS
missing_dependencies: no ROP/reorder_point identifier exists anywhere in the codebase — confirmed by exhaustive grep
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: not implemented — implementing it would require inventing a formula, which this phase explicitly forbids
metrics.verification_note: InventoryCoefficientEngine computes Safety Stock and Cycle Stock only; never combines them into a reorder point.

metrics.definition: Buffer inventory held against demand and lead-time variability.
metrics.formula: SS = z * sigma_d * sqrt(LT / days_per_period)  (deterministic lead time — no sigma_LT term)
metrics.authoritative_field: FacilityMarketInventoryCoeff.total_safety_stock_units (internal dataclass — NOT exposed via schemas/results.py; AssignmentDecision.safety_stock_units exists but is never populated by milp.py)
metrics.data_source: optimization.solve (internal to MILP construction; not exposed downstream)
missing_dependencies: AssignmentDecision.safety_stock_units field exists but milp.py never populates it
no orchestrator capability or ExecutionContext field carries this value out of the MILP
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: not implemented — no ExecutionContext access point exists; documented as a data gap rather than fabricating an integration
metrics.formula_note: Materially different from the pre-existing audit's claimed formula, which includes a lead-time-variance (sigma_LT) term that does not exist in the real code.

metrics.definition: Weiszfeld-iterated, inverse-distance-weighted geographic centroid of demand points.
metrics.formula: Iterative Weiszfeld algorithm, initialized at the demand-weighted centroid, converging under inverse-distance weighting
metrics.authoritative_field: CogResult / MultiCogResult (plain @dataclass — not a Pydantic schema field anywhere)
metrics.data_source: standalone — never wired into the MILP or the orchestrator
missing_dependencies: no schema field carries the result
explicitly documented as a geographic SCREENING tool only, not an optimization decision
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: not implemented — no ExecutionContext access point exists; documented as available-on-demand rather than orchestrator-integrated
metrics.formula_note: The pre-existing audit describes a single-shot weighted average and omits the entire iterative Weiszfeld minimization that is the actual algorithm.

metrics.definition: Forecast accuracy relative to a rolling one-step-naive benchmark, measured out-of-sample.
metrics.formula: mae / naive_mae, where naive_mae is the mean absolute error of a rolling-origin naive-1 forecast (NOT the classic in-sample first-difference denominator)
metrics.reasoning_relevance: not in _FACT_SPEC today — a genuine, narrow extension candidate for Phase 9.2
metrics.formula_note: The real out-of-sample rolling-origin naive benchmark differs in detail from the pre-existing audit's claimed classic in-sample scaling denominator (Hyndman & Koehler) — both are 'naive-1'-style but computed differently.

metrics.definition: Average absolute forecast error across backtest folds.
metrics.formula: mean(|y_actual - y_predicted|)

metrics.definition: Total absolute error as a fraction of total actual demand across backtest folds.
metrics.formula: sum(|error|) / sum(actual), else undefined (None) when total actual is ~0

metrics.definition: Quandt-Andrews sup-F test statistic for a level shift at the best-fitting candidate break point.
metrics.formula: max over candidate tau of F(tau) = (RSS_null - RSS_alt(tau)) / (RSS_alt(tau)/(n-k))
metrics.kpi_layer_wrapping: not wrapped in Phase 9.1 — ChangePointResult is nested inside SeriesForecast.structural_break rather than a network/facility scope; a candidate for Phase 9.2's forecast KPI expansion
metrics.verification_note: The pre-existing audit's entire CUSUM methodology claim (different statistic, different thresholds, different null model) is fabricated. Verified by direct read and repo-wide grep for 'CUSUM' (zero hits).
